candidates.source:
from patchproof.github_webhook import GitHubPullRequestWebhook, GitHubRepositoryPayload, GitHubPullRequestPayload, GitHubCommitRefPayload
from datetime import datetime, timezone

def test_pull_request_webhook_to_event_normalizes_title_whitespace() -> None:
    webhook = GitHubPullRequestWebhook(
        action="opened",
        number=1,
        repository=GitHubRepositoryPayload(full_name="owner/repo"),
        pull_request=GitHubPullRequestPayload(
            base=GitHubCommitRefPayload(sha="a" * 40),
            head=GitHubCommitRefPayload(sha="b" * 40),
            updated_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            title="  Normalize   this\n title  ",
            body="some body",
        ),
    )
    event = webhook.to_event("delivery-123")
    assert event.title == "Normalize this title"

candidates.source:
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from patchproof.github_webhook import GitHubPullRequestWebhook

def test_pull_request_webhook_to_event_normalizes_title_whitespace() -> None:
    payload = {
        "action": "opened",
        "number": 1,
        "repository": {"full_name": "owner/repo"},
        "pull_request": {
            "base": {"sha": "a" * 40},
            "head": {"sha": "b" * 40},
            "updated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "title": "  Normalize   this\n title  ",
            "body": "some body",
        },
    }
    webhook = GitHubPullRequestWebhook.model_validate(payload)
    event = webhook.to_event("delivery-123")
    assert event.title == "Normalize this title"
candidates.rationale: Repair the nonexistent import by using model_validate with a plain payload.
